entries.description: A value kept so it can be stored and read back. Get returns the value that was given. An empty storage returns an empty value. This is the store a session parameter or an event log uses for a value of any type (1C: ХранилищеЗначения).
entries.parameters: value — the value to keep. Left out, the storage is empty.

entries.description: The value this storage was given.
entries.return_descr: The stored value, or an empty value.
